title: HPP Attestation Request
description: The canonical attestation payload submitted by the client to POST /v1/attest after successful WebAuthn biometric verification. Every field is required. The nonce binds this request to a specific single-use challenge.

cert_id.description: UUID v4 generated client-side. Becomes the unique identifier for the resulting Presence Certificate. The client generates this before submission to enable inflight recovery if the service worker restarts.

nonce.description: The nonce from the challenge response. MUST match an issued, unconsumed challenge nonce. The server marks this nonce as consumed upon receipt — any second submission is rejected with 401 NONCE_ALREADY_USED.

rp_id.description: eTLD+1 (registrable domain) from the challenge. Must match the rp_id in the original challenge and the WebAuthn rp.id used during credential.get().

server_timestamp.description: Echoed from the challenge response. Allows the server to verify the challenge was recently issued without a separate lookup.

client_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds from the client device clock at submission time. Used by the server for clock skew analysis and telemetry. NOT used for security decisions — server_timestamp is authoritative.

credential_id.description: The WebAuthn credential identifier (rawId) from the authenticator assertion response. Hardware-bound to the user's device (Secure Enclave / TPM).

authenticator_data.description: Raw WebAuthn authenticatorData bytes from the assertion response. Layout: rpIdHash(32) | flags(1) | signCount(4) | extensions. The client MUST verify bit 2 (UV) is set before submission. The server independently verifies UV=1.

assertion_sig.description: ECDSA P-256 signature over SHA-256(authenticatorData || SHA-256(clientDataJSON)), produced by the platform authenticator's hardware-bound private key inside the TEE. This key never leaves the device.

client_data_json.description: Base64url-encoded clientDataJSON from the WebAuthn assertion. Contains type, challenge (matching nonce), origin, and crossOrigin fields. The server uses this for independent WebAuthn verification.

server_processing.description: Steps the verifier server executes upon receiving this payload.

steps.action: Verify nonce exists in the active challenge store and has not been consumed
Verify server_timestamp matches the original challenge
Verify submission arrived within window_ms of server_timestamp
Verify rp_id matches the challenge rp_id
Decode authenticator_data and verify UV flag (bit 2) is set
Look up the enrolled public key for credential_id + rp_id
Verify assertion_sig using the enrolled public key over SHA-256(authenticator_data || SHA-256(client_data_json))
Construct and sign the Presence Certificate

error_responses.401_NONCE_ALREADY_USED: Nonce has been consumed by a previous attestation
error_responses.401_UV_FLAG_MISSING: Authenticator data UV bit is not set
error_responses.408_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: Submission arrived outside the window_ms enforcement period
